findings.title: Missing compound unique index on Review (user_id + product_id)
findings.evidence: File: backend/models/Review.js:12, autoIndex: false, no compound index
findings.expected: Review schema must enforce unique compound index { user_id: 1, product_id: 1 } to prevent duplicate reviews
findings.actual: No unique index exists; duplicate reviews can be created indefinitely
findings.fix: Add reviewSchema.index({ user_id: 1, product_id: 1 }, { unique: true });

findings.title: Missing compound unique index on WishlistItem (user_id + product_id)
findings.evidence: File: backend/models/WishlistItem.js:10, autoIndex: false, no compound index
findings.expected: WishlistItem schema must enforce unique compound index { user_id: 1, product_id: 1 } to prevent spamming duplicate items
findings.actual: No unique index exists; duplicate wishlist entries can be created indefinitely
findings.fix: Add wishlistItemSchema.index({ user_id: 1, product_id: 1 }, { unique: true });

findings.title: Inconsistent timestamp field naming between models
findings.evidence: Review & WishlistItem use snake_case "created_at" whereas Order & User use camelCase "createdAt" (Mongoose timestamps)
findings.expected: All collections should follow consistent timestamp convention ("createdAt" and "updatedAt")
findings.actual: Models mix snake_case created_at with camelCase timestamps: true
findings.fix: Standardize timestamp convention across all Mongoose schemas

findings.title: Missing text/search index on Product (name, description, category)
findings.evidence: File: backend/models/Product.js, no text index defined
findings.expected: Fast catalog search requires compound or text index on name, category, and brand_id
findings.actual: Queries rely on regex table scans ($regex) without text index

findings.title: Lack of soft-delete pattern across catalog and transactional models
findings.expected: Production e-commerce systems should support soft-delete (isDeleted flag) to preserve order history integrity
findings.actual: Deleting a product or user can leave orphan references in historical orders and reviews
findings.fix: Implement soft-delete middleware with { isDeleted: { type: Boolean, default: false } }
